reason: Canonical requirements, scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and no-auto-promotion constraint for Legacy Project Profile Bootstrap.
Cross-layer architecture, flow definition, artifact metadata contract, backend-preflight behavior, and read-only runner design.
Implementation-level shared contracts, inventory/profile schemas, orchestrator behavior, artifact selection rules, and knowledge candidate generation details.
Required implementation order and phase-specific done conditions, starting with shared contracts.
Required unit, integration, E2E, and safety regression coverage for the implementation.
Shared thinking-guide index; cross-layer/reuse triggers apply because this task spans shared, API, runner, and web.
Task modifies shared constants/contracts and must search/reuse existing primitives before adding helpers.
Flow, artifact, knowledge, context, runner, API, and UI behavior must remain coherent across layers.
Shared backend spec index for workflow, context, artifact, and knowledge contract changes.
Profile flow must reuse project/request backend configuration and not introduce a separate backend path.
Accepted profile-derived knowledge must integrate through existing ContextPack governance and draft candidates must not become authoritative context.
Inventory/profile/completion/knowledge artifacts need digest-backed evidence and report semantics.
Runner backend spec index for orchestrator, flow registry, backend runtime, and inventory execution changes.
Adding profile.bootstrap must follow FLOW_REGISTRY, stage dispatch, flowId guard, and stage-order test contract.
Profile agent stage must use existing real CLI backend selection/preflight and fail closed when unavailable.
Tests should use deterministic fake backend fixtures where profile synthesis needs agent output.
API backend spec index for workflow request validation, store, report, and route changes.
POST /workflow-requests must accept type=profile and flowId=profile.bootstrap without regressing ask isolation.
API persistence changes must follow SQLite/migration discipline and avoid unnecessary new tables.
Profile bootstrap must not execute implementation/build_test project commands; build/test command handling must remain scoped to existing flows.
Web frontend spec index for project action/status/review UI changes.
Profile action UI must respect backend setup/preflight messaging and existing task/run stream surfaces.
Project profile action/status card must fit existing local/server state management patterns.
New profile run type/flow projections must stay typed and avoid stringly-typed UI regressions.
